program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 8.0, 22.0),     # gain NMOS gm/Id: low noise, small Cgg
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "I1":    (5e-6, 2e-6, 10e-6),   # gain-stage current
    "gmid2": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),     # source follower
    "L2":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "I2":    (7.5e-6, 3e-6, 12e-6), # follower current (sets the CL pole)
    "gmid3": (6.0, 4.0, 12.0),      # PMOS load: low gm/Id for low noise
    "L3":    (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),
    "Rf":    (470e3, 400e3, 650e3),
    "Cf":    (0.5e-15, 0.1e-15, 5e-15),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    VDD = 1.8
    I1, I2, Ipb = p["I1"], p["I2"], 0.6e-6
    Rf, Cf = p["Rf"], p["Cf"]
    gb, Lb = 8.0, 1.0                       # bias-mirror gm/Id and L

    # Gain stage: gate DC = Vgs1 = vout DC (no DC current in Rf)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.1)
    vg = m1.vgs
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I2, vds=VDD - vg, vsb=vg)
    vx = vg + m2.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vx)
    vg = m1.vgs
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I2, vds=VDD - vg, vsb=vg)
    vx = vg + m2.vgs

    # PMOS load and its diode reference (same gm/Id and L, so currents scale)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=max(VDD - vx, 0.2))
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Ipb, vds=m3.vgs)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Ipb, vds=m7.vgs)

    # NMOS bias mirror from IREF
    m5 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=m5.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, I2, vds=vg)
    m6 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, Ipb, vds=VDD - m7.vgs)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M6", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    n.dev("M5", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M2", "vdd", "x", "vout", "vss", m2)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m4)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "iin", Cf)

    # ---- analytic model ----
    gx = m1.gds + m3.gds
    A1 = m1.gm / gx
    gsf = m2.gm + m2.gmbs + m2.gds + m4.gds
    Asf = m2.gm / gsf
    T0 = A1 * Asf
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg
    Cft = Cf + m1.cgd
    cgs2 = max(m2.cgg - m2.cgd, 0.0)
    Cx = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m2.cgd + cgs2 * (1 - Asf) + 1e-15
    wa = gx / Cx
    Csf = cl + m4.cdd + m2.cgg * 0.1 + 2e-15
    wsf = gsf / Csf

    f = np.logspace(4, 10, 3000)
    s = 1j * 2 * PI * f
    H = T0 / ((1 + s / wa) * (1 + s / wsf))
    Y = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cft
    Zt = np.abs(-1.0 / ((s * Cin + Y) / H + Y))
    z0 = Zt[0]
    below = np.where(Zt < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = float(f[below[0]]) if len(below) else 1e10

    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300.0
    en2 = kT4 * (2.0 / 3.0) * (m1.gm + m3.gm) / m1.gm ** 2
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    Ytot2 = (1.0 / Rf) ** 2 + (w * (Cin + Cft)) ** 2
    noise_i = math.sqrt(kT4 / Rf + en2 * Ytot2)

    power = VDD * (iref + I1 + I2 + Ipb)
    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "in_noise_1m": noise_i,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vg,
    }
